name: RGB-D Plenoxel Mapping
definition: A dense mapping algorithm that extends the Plenoxel model to incorporate depth data from an RGB-D sensor, removing ambiguities in gradient-less regions.
summary: RGB-D Plenoxel Mapping is a fast, dense mapping algorithm that uses RGB-D sensor data to resolve geometric ambiguities in gradient-less regions, outperforming standard NeRF.
